args.script: p=op('/project1'); geo=p.op('inst_geo') or p.create(geoCOMP,'inst_geo'); cam=p.op('inst_cam') or p.create(cameraCOMP,'inst_cam'); light=p.op('inst_light') or p.create(lightCOMP,'inst_light'); render=p.op('inst_render') or p.create(renderTOP,'inst_render'); blur=p.op('inst_luma_blur') or p.create(lumaBlurTOP,'inst_luma_blur'); out=p.op('FINAL_OUT') or p.create(nullTOP,'FINAL_OUT'); [c.destroy() for c in list(geo.children)]; box=geo.create(boxSOP,'instance_box'); grid=geo.create(gridSOP,'instance_grid'); grid.par.rows=20; grid.par.cols=20; sop_to_chop=geo.create(soptoCHOP,'grid_to_chop'); sop_to_chop.par.sop=grid.path; sop_to_chop.par.channame='tx ty tz'; noise=geo.create(noiseCHOP,'inst_noise'); noise.par.channame='scale colorr colorg colorb'; noise.par.period=6; noise.par.amp=0.5; merge=geo.create(mergeCHOP,'inst_merge'); merge.inputConnectors[0].connect(sop_to_chop); merge.inputConnectors[1].connect(noise); null_chop=geo.create(nullCHOP,'inst_chop_out'); null_chop.inputConnectors[0].connect(merge); box.render=True; box.display=True; grid.render=False; grid.display=False; geo.par.instance=1 if hasattr(geo.par,'instance') else None; geo.par.instancing=1 if hasattr(geo.par,'instancing') else None; geo.par.instanceop=null_chop.path if hasattr(geo.par,'instanceop') else None; geo.par.instancingop=null_chop.path if hasattr(geo.par,'instancingop') else None; geo.par.itx='tx' if hasattr(geo.par,'itx') else None; geo.par.ity='ty' if hasattr(geo.par,'ity') else None; geo.par.itz='tz' if hasattr(geo.par,'itz') else None; geo.par.iscale='scale' if hasattr(geo.par,'iscale') else None; geo.par.iusecolor=True if hasattr(geo.par,'iusecolor') else None; geo.par.icolorr='colorr' if hasattr(geo.par,'icolorr') else None; geo.par.icolorg='colorg' if hasattr(geo.par,'icolorg') else None; geo.par.icolorb='colorb' if hasattr(geo.par,'icolorb') else None; render.par.camera=cam.path; render.par.lights=light.path; render.par.geometry=geo.path; blur.inputConnectors[0].connect(render); out.inputConnectors[0].connect(blur); cam.par.tz=18 if hasattr(cam.par,'tz') else None; light.par.tx=3 if hasattr(light.par,'tx') else None; light.par.ty=6 if hasattr(light.par,'ty') else None; light.par.tz=8 if hasattr(light.par,'tz') else None
